# TallyBook

> TallyBook is free, offline, keyboard-first desktop accounting software for Indian small businesses, made by Techardent Labs (Techardent Internet Pvt. Ltd.). It runs natively on Windows 10/11, macOS 11+ (Apple chip and Intel) and Linux, and follows the TallyPrime keyboard workflow (Gateway menu, F4–F9 vouchers, Alt+G Go To). It is not affiliated with Tally Solutions.

Key facts:
- Price: free; no licence fee and no yearly renewal.
- Data: stored only on the user's computer; backup and restore built in.
- Features: GST invoices (CGST/SGST/IGST), GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, HSN summary, e-invoice and e-way bill JSON for offline upload; inventory with godowns, batches, price levels and FIFO/LIFO/average/standard costing; payroll with PF, ESI and professional tax; TDS/TCS; bank reconciliation, cheque register and printing; cost centres, budgets and interest calculation; Balance Sheet, P&L, Trial Balance, Day Book, registers, cash flow, funds flow, ratios; users, roles and passwords; import from Tally XML and Excel/CSV.
- Limitations (version 0.1): single user per computer (no network multi-user), installers not yet code-signed, GST returns are prepared for upload on the GST portal rather than filed from the app, no manufacturing/BOM or job work, some voucher-entry features (foreign-currency entry, batch allocation, price-list rates, order tracking) not yet connected.
- Updates: automatic in-app updates; monthly feature releases; statutory fixes released as needed.
